Additional Materials: Answer Booklet/Paper
READ THESE INSTRUCTIONS FIRST
An answer booklet is provided inside this question paper. You should follow the instructions on the front cover
of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
The number of marks is given in brackets [ ] at the end of each question or part question.
The syllabus is approved for use in England, Wales and Northern Ireland as a Cambridge International Level 1/Level 2 Certificate.
This document consists of 3 printed pages and 1 blank page.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–1918
1 How significant was the entry into the war of the British Expeditionary Force in 1914? Explain your
answer. [40]
How important was the Zimmermann Telegram as a reason for US entry into the war in 1917?
Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–1945
How significant were the Spartacists to the instability of Germany,1918–23? Explain your answer.
How important was control of the media in strengthening Nazi rule in Germany after 1934? Explain
your answer.
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–1941
How important was Rasputin as a cause of growing opposition to Tsarist rule in Russia? Explain
your answer.
How significant was the New Economic Policy as a reason for the introduction of Stalin's Five-Year
Plans? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY D: THE USA, 1919–1941
How important was immigration as a cause of intolerance in US society in the 1920s? Explain your
answer. [40]
How significant was the impact of the New Deal on the unemployed? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important were the actions of the Kuomintang as a reason for the growth in support for the
Chinese Communist Party? Explain your answer.
How significant was the role of the USA in the emergence of China as a world power? Explain your
answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How important to the development of the South African economy by 1945 was gold mining? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant was the impact of government legislation on the lives of non-white South Africans
during the 1950s? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How significant was Palestinian terrorism in promoting the Palestinian cause? Explain your answer.
How important was the election of Likud in 1977 to relations between Israel and its neighbours?
Explain your answer.
